partner_result.applied_scope: For A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m), all nonzero principal 3x3 determinants are m^-2, any randomized determinant-first selector pays m^(2/3), while overlap-one third-compound squared-minor mass tends to one.

mathematical_change.statement: For every bounded measurable 0<=Phi<=1, the supremum over independent cap-one probability densities equals the supremum over product indicators of arbitrary unit-measure sets, and is unchanged by restricting each set to a bounded finite union of intervals of total measure one. Therefore a uniform interval small-ball constant transfers with zero loss to all cap-one product laws.

For A=[[B,C],[C^T,D]], conditioning outside and shifting by B^dagger Cz leaves only kernel leakage P_Ker(B) C z. If Ran(C) subset Ran(B), any pure-active law-uniform density cap transfers to the full matrix with exactly the same constant, including singular B and arbitrary outside rank/couplings/support geometry.

For a direct sum of disjoint physical rank-one active banks with at least three coefficients of magnitude at least one and range-aligned outside coupling, the full quadratic density is at most 2*pi; if a selected same-sign pair contains a singleton bank, at most pi*sqrt(2).

For the partner family A_m, Q=X0^2+U_m^2-V_m^2 has density at most pi*sqrt(2)<4.443 for every m and every cap-one product law, despite determinant-first cost m^(2/3). The same bound persists after arbitrary outside block/couplings with Ran(C) subset Ran(A_m).
